## Goal

Maintain the shared lab meeting repository so that meeting schedules, agendas, and presentation materials are organized and accessible to the group.

## Prerequisites

- Access to the Pollack Group lab meeting repository
- Basic familiarity with Git and GitHub

See the [Version Control](../../computing/version-control.qmd) guide for our general approach and recommended learning resources.
